1.title: Graham’s Death Complicates G.O.P. Agenda in Congress
1.summary: Senators returned to the Capitol mourning their colleague, who played pivotal roles on multiple issues confronting lawmakers.

2.title: Lorenzo Salgado Araujo Chased the American Dream for 35 Years Before Fatal ICE Shooting
2.summary: Lorenzo Salgado Araujo hoped to obtain legal status, his family said. He was killed last week by an immigration agent who was looking for a different man.

3.title: Wildfires Close Popular National Forest Area in Minnesota
3.summary: Several fires in northeastern Minnesota are causing dangerous conditions and smoke in the Boundary Waters Canoe Area, which is used for camping and other outdoor recreation.

4.title: Live Updates: U.S. Forces Begin New Round of Strikes on Iran
4.summary: President Trump had earlier threatened “very hard” strikes, ordered the resumption of a blockade on Iranian ports to begin Tuesday and said the U.S. would charge a 20 percent fee on goods passing through the Strait of Hormuz.

5.title: UAE condemns Iran's 'brazen' attack on tankers as US launches fresh strikes
5.summary: The third consecutive night of US strikes on Iran came as Trump announced a 20% charge as part of a new blockade on the strait.

6.title: 'Hero, legend, sweetheart': Tributes to Jurassic Park actor Sam Neill, who has died aged 78
6.summary: Friends, politicians and fellow film stars remember Neill following his "sudden and unexpected" death.
